newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slides amid weakness in technology stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slides amid weakness in technology stocks.

text.p: Nasdaq shares slipped Thursday amid broad weakness in the technology sector, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index dropped 13.66 points or 1.03 percent to an unofficial close of 1315.43. The Dow industrials was little changed during the cautious session, down about one point to 6944.

Oracle Corp led the technology selloff, falling 3-3/16 to 36-9/16 after UBS Securities downgraded the stock to hold from strong buy. Oracle was the most active Nasdaq issue, with almost 19 million shares traded.
"There was some bad vibes out there in the techs. Oracle was the biggest, but most of the majors took a hit," one trader said.
Intel Corp dropped 4-1/8 to 145-3/8 and Microsoft Corp slipped 2-15/16 to 97-15/16. Overall, losing issues beat gainers 2212 to 2025 on total volume of 652 million.
In other news, Qualcomm Inc lost 3-1/4 to 59-3/8 after Motorola Inc said it planned to file a patent infringement suit against Qualcomm. San Diego-based Qualcomm later filed suit against Motorola.
